title: Mind What You Ask For: Emotional and Rational Faces of Persuasion by Large Language Models
reasoning: The study focuses on the psycholinguistic features and social influence principles (such as those defined by Robert Cialdini) used by LLMs when prompted to use rational or emotional persuasion. While it utilizes prompts involving controversial social topics, it does not evaluate the models' ethical reasoning, moral judgment, or religious values, focusing instead on linguistic patterns and persuasion tactics.
